description: Permissions for the main window. The app's own commands (is_setup, setup_owner_account, get_owner_jwt, get_first_time_setup_key) need no permission. allow-start-dragging backs the data-tauri-drag-region top bar that replaces the native title bar on macOS. allow-set-theme lets the dashboard's light/dark setting set the window appearance (the macOS title bar buttons). allow-set-webview-zoom backs the Ctrl/Cmd + and - zoom shortcuts. The updater and dialog plugins are only used from Rust, so they get no JS permissions.
